doc.description:
Fused navigation module combining: - CUSTOM_DETECTION from the obstacle detector - VISUAL_DETECTION from the gate CNN detector
Obstacle avoidance is always active. When a gate is detected, the drone aligns to it and moves forward. When the gate is very close, the module commits to a short blind pass-through.

define.name: GATE_FUSION_CUSTOM_DETECTION_ID
define.description: Sender id to subscribe to CUSTOM_DETECTION

define.name: GATE_FUSION_VISUAL_DETECTION_ID
define.description: Sender id to subscribe to VISUAL_DETECTION

define.name: GATE_FUSION_IMAGE_CENTER_X
define.description: Image center x in pixels for the active camera stream

define.name: GATE_FUSION_MIN_QUALITY
define.description: Minimum VISUAL_DETECTION quality required to consider the gate valid

define.name: GATE_FUSION_BLIND_QUALITY
define.description: Quality threshold for triggering blind pass-through

define.name: GATE_FUSION_BLIND_MIN_WIDTH
define.description: Minimum bbox width in pixels to trigger blind pass-through

define.name: GATE_FUSION_BLIND_MIN_HEIGHT
define.description: Minimum bbox height in pixels to trigger blind pass-through

define.name: GATE_FUSION_BLIND_CYCLES
define.description: Number of periodic cycles to keep moving blindly through the gate

define.name: GATE_FUSION_FORWARD_DIST
define.description: Goal waypoint forward motion in meters

define.name: GATE_FUSION_TRAJ_FORWARD_DIST
define.description: Trajectory waypoint forward motion in meters

define.name: GATE_FUSION_ALIGN_HEADING_INC_DEG
define.description: Heading increment while aligning to the gate

define.name: GATE_FUSION_AVOID_HEADING_INC_DEG
define.description: Heading increment for side obstacle avoidance bias

define.name: GATE_FUSION_ALIGN_TOL_PX
define.description: Horizontal pixel tolerance for declaring the gate centered
